description: This file defines the HomeFragment class which constructs the main home screen of an Android TV application. It manages a top navigation bar and multiple content rows, each containing horizontally scrollable focusable content cards. The fragment uses RecyclerViews with adapters to display mock content, supporting TV navigation features, accessibility, and theming considerations.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Represents the main fragment for the Android TV home screen, hosting navigation and content display with focus handling and accessibility support.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout using ViewBinding and returns the root view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the top navigation and content rails after view creation.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Sets up the horizontal top navigation RecyclerView with categories and initial focus.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Prepares the vertical list of content rows, each with mock data, for browsing.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears the binding reference to prevent memory leaks.
